en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph depicting a large, elegant villa or manor house set in landscaped gardens. The building has two main stories plus an attic with dormer windows, a tiled hip roof, symmetrical façades with classical elements such as columned porticos, pediments, and balustraded balconies. Ivy climbs one side of the house, and tall trees and manicured lawn surround it, suggesting a wealthy suburban or countryside residence. The image is framed with a white border typical of vintage postcards.
